name: tavern-battle
description: 战阵 —— SillyTavern / TauriTavern 原生回合制战斗扩展

scripts.build:extension: node scripts/check-jev-vendor.mjs && vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
scripts.test:extension: vitest run host/tests runtime/tests panel/src/auto-battle.test.ts panel/src/report-history.test.ts panel/src/report-epilogue.test.ts panel/src/jev-command.test.ts panel/src/jev-context.test.ts panel/src/jev-retry.test.ts panel/src/jev-connection.test.ts panel/src/jev-transport.test.ts panel/src/main.integration.test.ts
scripts.verify:extension: npm run typecheck && npm run test:extension && npm run test:jev-relay && npm run verify:compatibility && npm run build:extension && npm run smoke:extension
scripts.build:dist: npm run build:worldbook && vite build panel && vite build --config panel/controller.vite.config.ts && node scripts/pack-loader.mjs
scripts.build:aligned: vite build panel --outDir ../release/source-aligned-candidate && vite build --config panel/controller.vite.config.ts --outDir release/source-aligned-candidate && node scripts/pack-loader.mjs --candidate
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:dist
